title: Spindletap Brewery
gap: Prices for beer and food not stated
blurb: SpindleTap Brewery offers a taproom and outdoor park on 3.5 acres with activities like Putt Putt Golf, Corn Hole, Pickleball, Horse Shoes, Soccer, Wiffle Ball, and Kickball. The taproom is climate-controlled with plenty of seating, TVs, and a large selection of craft beer on tap and in cans. The outdoor area includes a new expanded hangout space with fireside seating for relaxation.
